# ZAP baseline rule overrides. Tab-separ: # WARN keeps a finding visible in the report; IGNORE drops it entirely.
# GitHub Pages serves every file from one fixed header set that Orbit cannot
# change — there is no server config and no edge worker on the free tier. The
# headers below are therefore not actionable here, and are enforced instead by
# the <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy"> in index.html where a meta
# tag is allowed to carry them. Left as WARN, not IGNORE, so they still show up
# if Orbit ever moves to a host that can set real headers.

DESCRIPTION: Strict-Transport-Security — set by GitHub Pages, not by us
CSP header — delivered via meta tag; Pages cannot set headers
